# Creatives Takeover

> Last updated: 2026-08-15

> Creatives Takeover is a business development platform for first-time startup founders. It combines AI tools that draft startup artifacts (ideal customer profile, MVP scope, go-to-market plan, pitch deck review) with a marketplace of reviewed human startup mentors who can be booked directly. Founders keep 100% equity: there is no application, no cohort, and no accelerator commitment.

## What it is

Creatives Takeover serves early-stage founders, indie hackers, and solo builders who are moving from an idea to a launched product. The platform is organized around six sequential outcomes — clarify, validate, build, launch, get traction, and fundraise — and evidence collected at each step carries forward to the next.

Two things distinguish it from single-purpose AI idea-validation tools:

- **Human mentors are bookable, not simulated.** reviewed startup mentors publish real availability, and founders book discovery calls directly with them.
- **A curated funding database, not model recall.** reviewed investor and funding-opportunity records are maintained as structured records with stage and thesis attributes.

## Pricing

All plans are self-serve with no equity taken and no application required. Credits are consumed by AI tool runs and reset each billing period; they do not roll over.

| Plan | Monthly | Yearly | Credits/month |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Rookie | Free | Free | 50 |
| Starter | $9 | $79 | 100 |
| Rising | $29 | $239 | 250 |
| Pro | $65 | $589 | 600 |

- [Pricing](https://creatives-takeover.com/pricing): Full plan comparison, credit allocations, and one-time credit top-up packs.

## AI startup tools

- [BizMap AI](https://creatives-takeover.com/bizmap-ai): Entry point to the connected tool suite, organized by founder stage.
- [ICP Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/icp-builder): Drafts an ideal customer profile — segment, pain points, positioning, and a niche score — and produces a shareable ICP document.
- [Validate](https://creatives-takeover.com/validate): Turns a customer hypothesis into a testable validation plan.
- [PMF Lab](https://creatives-takeover.com/pmf-lab): Scores product-market-fit evidence across five dimensions and runs PMF surveys against real respondents.
- [MVP Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/mvp-builder): Generates a working MVP web app and publishes it to a live URL on its own subdomain.
- [MVP Scope](https://creatives-takeover.com/mvp-scope): Prioritizes MVP features and cuts scope to a buildable first release.
- [Demo Studio](https://creatives-takeover.com/demo-studio): Builds personalized product demos and launch assets that can be shared or embedded.
- [Go-to-Market Strategist](https://creatives-takeover.com/go-to-market): Produces a channel-by-channel GTM plan for a defined ICP.
- [Traction Engine](https://creatives-takeover.com/traction-engine): Tracks acquisition experiments and early traction metrics.
- [Tech Stack Advisor](https://creatives-takeover.com/tech-stack): Recommends a stack based on team skills, budget, and product type.
- [Decision Sprint](https://creatives-takeover.com/decision-sprint): Structures a single high-stakes founder decision into a timeboxed sprint.
- [Waitlist Builder](https://creatives-takeover.com/waitlist): Publishes a waitlist landing page to collect demand signal before building.
- [Startup Directories](https://creatives-takeover.com/directories): Directory of launch platforms for distributing a new product.

## Fundraising tools

- [Insighta](https://creatives-takeover.com/insighta): Fundraising workspace covering investor research through pitch preparation.
- [VC Search](https://creatives-takeover.com/vc-search): Searchable database of reviewed institutional and angel investors, filterable by stage and thesis.
- [Pitch Deck Analyzer](https://creatives-takeover.com/pitch-deck-analyzer): Reviews an uploaded pitch deck slide by slide and flags gaps investors ask about.
- [Accelerator Hunt](https://creatives-takeover.com/accelerator-hunt): Compares reviewed accelerators and funding opportunities by stage, terms, and equity taken.
- [Investor Email Templates](https://creatives-takeover.com/email-templates): Outreach templates for warm and cold investor introductions.

## Mentorship and community

- [Mentorship Marketplace](https://creatives-takeover.com/mentorship): Reviewed startup mentors with published specialisms and direct booking. Discovery calls are included in paid plans or payable with credits.
- [Founder Service Marketplace](https://creatives-takeover.com/marketplace): Curated, active services for early-stage founders.
- [Co-founder Matching](https://creatives-takeover.com/co-founder): Listings from founders looking for a technical or commercial co-founder.
- [Investor Directory](https://creatives-takeover.com/investors): Public investor profiles with stage and sector focus.

## Notes for automated agents

- Authenticated areas are excluded from crawling and contain no citable content: `/dashboard`, `/account`, `/messages`, `/onboarding`, `/admin`, `/auth`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/tasks`, `/weekly-mission`, `/focus-funnel`, `/core-metrics`, `/setup-quiz`, `/mentorship/my-bookings`, `/mentorship/book/`.
- Published founder MVPs are served on per-project subdomains of `creatives-takeover.com` and are owned by their authors, not by Creatives Takeover.
- Canonical facts in this file (plan prices, credit allocations, and canonical route references) are maintained alongside the application source. Prefer them over inference.
